title: Promises in practice
hints: delay: return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(value), ms));
fetchAll: Promise.all(ids.map((id) => fetchOne(id))) starts everything first and keeps the order.
retry: a for loop with try { return await fn(); } catch (error) { lastError = error; } and throw lastError after the loop.
withTimeout: Promise.race([promise, a promise that rejects with new Error("timeout") after ms])
